scope: One explicitly configured synthetic real Node child; ACP v1 text session, one active prompt, cancellation and bounded shutdown. No actual AI login/agent integration.

acp.execution: Real synthetic subprocess fixtures; no actual agent/model.

tests.contracts: 10 declarations via normal contract gate, including strict ACP API usage fixture
tests.fullSuite: Linux CI will be required separately; prior Windows V8 issue remains unresolved.

repaired: close during initialize/new must not publish ready
explicit close settles pending prompt without false failure
stdin backpressure rejects an outgoing reply backlog
stdout received after failure is discarded during shutdown
independentReview.additionalRegression: A session/new response plus immediate notification in the same stdout chunk is buffered until session identity is available.
independentReview.protocolGate: Pinned schema requires capabilities for notice/compaction; the text client does not advertise them and refuses them.

securityBoundaries: No auth execution, discovery, installation, PATH search, MCP delegation or browser wiring
Client permissions always cancelled; filesystem/terminal methods refused
Conversation text is returned only by explicit prompt result, never diagnostics/evidence; raw remote error text is not exposed
Cancellation closes the old session before reuse; descendants beyond owned child not proven terminated
unverified: Malicious normal-completion old notifications have no turn id in v1 and cannot be generally attributed to a later turn
